method: Eight full individual source images directly viewed, including both repairs. Compared with their saved prompts; no contact-sheet-only inspection.
scope: Finished gallery key art. Explicit local supernatural geometry in b11/b12 is intentional, not a realism defect.

Four distinct walking-leg contacts are now much easier to follow beneath the two blade forelimbs.
Loaded climbing posture and local red-membrane/olive-chitin contrast retain weight and readable form.

nonblocking_limits: The face/hair/coat register is relatively close to Ithraden; distinct cannon and kneeling profile carry most of this character differentiation.

evidence: Empty cloth head remains a physical folded form rather than a generic smoke face.

evidence: Articulated architectural arches and empty centre create a nonhumanoid boss identity.
Dust at the rotating contact and interrupted stair express route-changing action.
Dark chamber versus pale stone construct gives strong material and focal separation.
nonblocking_limits: Three supports are clearly visible; the fourth is occluded by the stair/body. Do not claim this as a four-foot orthographic verification.

evidence: Ice-breaking forepaw and powerful shoulder mass communicate physical threat without a snarling mascot expression.
Frost-matted hair, water, ice fragments and timber scale form a coherent glacial environment.
Tiny observer and cold/warm lighting hierarchy establish encounter stakes.
nonblocking_limits: Base animal silhouette remains recognizably ursid; distinctiveness comes from forequarter proportions, restraint scars and ice-floor interaction.

conclusion: All eight accepted. b04 weapon-topology blocker is resolved. b07 leg separation materially improved. No new publication blocker found.
